caption:
Anxiety before a hard day? Remember who is with you.

Musa and Harun told their Lord they were afraid. His answer was not to fear, because He was with them both, hearing and seeing. Carry that into whatever you are dreading today.

Surah Taa-Haa 20:45-46

Name the one thing you are nervous about today, then make dua about it.
